1879064142.Skill_Desc: Increases the movement speed of the Fellowship.

1879064398.Skill_Desc: When active, increases damage of shots.\n\nQuick Shot slows enemy movement speed.

1879073358.Skill_Desc: Nock and loose an arrow quickly.\n\nArrows inflict fire damage.

1879073486.Skill_Desc: You can raise your Fellowship's Hope value through good old-fashioned hobbit-cheer. This does not stack with other Hope buffs.

1879073614.Skill_Desc: You provide a bonus to your Fellowship's Vitality.

1879073742.Skill_Desc: You can spit a crippling poison in a spray, hitting enemies in front of you up to a short distance away.

1879104846.Skill_Desc: When finished casting, Fell Restoration instantly restores a huge amount of health to target.

1879115214.Skill_Desc: Goads nearby targets to attack the Warden.

1879136206.Skill_Desc: You focus on damaging your opponents.

1879138638.Skill_Desc: A coating of slick mud provides protection against critical attacks and helps ease the sting of ill effects on yourself.

1879197902.Skill_Desc: Summons a raven companion.\n\nThe raven specializes in buffing and debuffing.

1879213902.Skill_Desc: Your fellowship attempts to strike Draigoch with a final blow.

1879216334.Skill_Desc: Restores your power and decreases your attack duration while forcing all surrounding enemies to attack you.

1879233358.Skill_Desc:
Wardens find strength in the sure knowledge that they are fighting to defend the defenceless.
Drains significant morale from nearby enemies over time to heal the Warden.

<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879242318.Skill_Desc:
<rgb=#66fff>Mounted Discipline</rgb>

Mounted Disciplines are used to alter the attitude and tactics used by your War-steed in Mounted Combat.

<rgb=#66ffff>Red Dawn</rgb>

The Red Dawn Discipline allows the Lore-master to become the true master of knowledge and gain complete understanding of the world and how it works, supplying them with their most potent arsenal of abilities.

1879243982.Skill_Desc: A damaging cry that has the potential to truly disrupt your enemies and inspire you and your allies.

1879244238.Skill_Desc: A good Burglar knows how to plan for any situation and how to apply their knowledge to the best outcome at all times.

1879244878.Skill_Desc: This quick strike saps your target's morale and has a chance on a critical strike to restore morale to you and your war-steed.

1879248334.Skill_Desc:
You unleash the culmination of your musical efforts into a powerful and effective heal for you and up to eight friendly targets nearby.

<rgb=#00FFDD>Requires 3 ballad buffs present on the Minstrel.</rgb>
<rgb=#00FFDD>Active Anthems add enhanced effects to the Coda.</rgb>

<rgb=#FF7700>Removes all Ballads from the Minstrel.</rgb>
<rgb=#FF7700>Removes all Anthems from Minstrel.</rgb>

1879255502.Skill_Desc: The initial impact of your weapon is meant to injure your foe, but the true damage is unleashed as you drag your weapon across your foe's flesh.

1879286478.Skill_Desc: The tripwire will knockdown enemies making them more vulnerable to attacks and easier for allies to land critical hits on them.

1879301198.Skill_Desc: A horse from the Yule Festival.
1879301198.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available in the Yule Festival for Mithril Coins.

1879302606.Skill_Desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Victory into battle. This banner reduces power costs of those around it.
1879302606.Skill_Name: Call to Arms: Herald of Victory (Footsoldier)

1879305550.Skill_Desc: This attack does additional damage for each point of Focus consumed.

1879316046.Skill_Desc: Slash a single target and generate Wrath. Has a chance to place a healing buff on the Beorning.

1879335502.Skill_Desc: Summons a Swan-knight Rider of Dol Amroth to keep you company.

1879344462.Skill_Desc: Though excellent at guarding crops, this fellow is not very good in true combat situations. Still, he provides pleasant company.

1879345102.Skill_Desc: A token of thanks for your actions before the Battle of the Black Gate.

1879381582.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Limited time availability for Figments of Splendour.

1879492174.Skill_Desc: You compel your allies to ambush your enemies, improving speed and aggression for as long as they can maintain the element of surprise.

1879514062.Skill_Desc: A little goat who would like to see the world with you.

1879524430.Skill_Desc: You are known to really enjoy these pies.
